raw: Van der Brempt I. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+9' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90+9' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Fiorentina have been awarded a free kick.
90+8' Jayden Addai (Como) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
90+6' The substitution is prepared. Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergi Roberto.
90+4' 1 - 2 Jayden Addai (Como) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating David de Gea with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
90+2' Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Kevin Bonacina shows a yellow card to Simon Sohm (Fiorentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

89' Anastasios Douvikas sprays a pass out to Sergi Roberto (Como), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
88' Dodo (Fiorentina) is booked for saying more than Kevin Bonacina was willing to tolerate.

86' Jayden Addai (Como) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

84' Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
82' Here is a change. Alex Valle is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Stefan Posch (Como).
81' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
78' Nico Paz (Como) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
78' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Mattia Viti (Fiorentina) replaces Luca Ranieri.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Roberto Piccoli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina).
77' A yellow card for a tackle by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como). Kevin Bonacina doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
76' Nico Paz (Como) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from David de Gea stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
76' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
75' Nico Paz (Como) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

74' CHANCE! Jesus Rodriguez (Como) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Nico Paz. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
72' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle and signals a foul after Moise Kean (Fiorentina) brought his opponent down.
69' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' Kevin Bonacina shows the yellow card to Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) for a heavy challenge.
67' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is flagged for offside.
67' Nico Paz (Como) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but David de Gea was alert and made an astonishing save!

65' 1 - 1 Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) outjumps the defence in the centre of the box and connects with the free kick from Nico Paz. He sends the ball into the top right corner with his towering header and alters the score to 1:1.
65' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
63' Unbelievable miss! Alex Valle (Como) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
62' Rolando Mandragora comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina).
62' Substitution. Jacopo Fazzini did his best and is replaced by Simon Sohm (Fiorentina).
61' That's the end of the game for Alvaro Morata, who is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Como).
61' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn will be replaced by Jayden Addai (Como).
60' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) commits a foul and Kevin Bonacina immediately signals a free kick.
59' Dodo (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
57' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
54' A rebound falls kindly for Sergi Roberto (Como), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
53' Nico Paz (Como) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

53' Sergi Roberto (Como) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the top right corner. David de Gea has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. Como win a corner kick.
52' Nico Paz (Como) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
51' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
50' Today's referee Kevin Bonacina rightly decides to book Sergi Roberto (Como) for his harsh tackle.
49' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) attempts to find Jesus Rodriguez, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' Substitution. Mergim Vojvoda is replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Como).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Kevin Bonacina has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+8' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Diego Carlos (Como) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
45+8' Nico Paz (Como) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
45+7' The Como players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Kevin Bonacina. NO PENALTY!
45+4' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Como as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

45+4' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Como are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
45+1' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Nico Paz (Como) sends a chip pass into the box, but David de Gea is quickest to intercept the ball.
41' Como fail to score from a corner as David de Gea (Fiorentina) leaps to collect the ball.
40' Dodo (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jean Butez, who smothers the ball.
39' A quickly taken corner by Como.

39' Alvaro Morata (Como) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Como have a corner.

38' Nico Paz (Como) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but David de Gea was alert and the score remained the same.
36' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
34' Referee Kevin Bonacina halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Stefano Pioli, then shows him a yellow.
34' Alvaro Morata (Como) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
30' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) sees a yellow card from Kevin Bonacina after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
29' Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
28' A mistimed header from the middle of the box by Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
27' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner.
26' A cooling break is underway.
24' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
22' Tariq Lamptey is substituted due to injury. Stefano Pioli gives a chance to Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina).

21' What a chance that is! Maximo Perrone (Como) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
21' Nico Paz (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
19' The game is interrupted now, Tariq Lamptey (Fiorentina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
16' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

15' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Tariq Lamptey (Fiorentina) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jean Butez comes off the line to clear the ball away.
12' Kevin Bonacina interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mergim Vojvoda (Como).

11' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
10' Flag goes up against Mergim Vojvoda (Como) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Kevin Bonacina had an easy-decision to make.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom right corner. It's 1:0.
6' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
5' Ivan Smolcic (Como) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Fiorentina.
2' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Como will kick the game off.
Kevin Bonacina will referee today's match.
